submission.justification: In simulation, Mixture-G1 at a 1.9 mm gap gave the best time resolution, 0.866 ns. The best G3 result was 1.264 ns at 2 mm, and the best G2 result was 1.934 ns at 2 mm. One constraint is unverified. The environmental policy document was not found among the 6 documents read, so I could not check whether G1 complies. No mixtures were excluded, but that only reflects the missing policy. G1 is recommended provisionally, and the policy compliance check must be done before adoption. G3 at 2 mm (1.264 ns) is the fallback if G1 turns out to be non-compliant.

requirements.evidence: G1 at 1.9 mm gave 0.866 ns, the lowest of all simulated mixture and gap combinations. The next best were G1 at 2.1 mm (0.873 ns) and G1 at 2 mm (0.9 ns).
